newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philex unit says gold mine looks promising.
newsitem.headline: Philex unit says gold mine looks promising.

text.p: Philex Gold Inc, a unit of Philex Mining Corp, said exploratory drillings in its new gold mine in southern Philippines had confirmed high gold grade.

"In-fill drilling carried out ... on the Lalab vein system has confirmed the continuity of gold mineralisation in the West Lalab vein structures, which will ultimately increase both the tonnage and grade of the resource," Philex said in a statement released in Manila.
Earlier estimates put the ore content to be at 12.24 million tonnes averaging 2.25 grams of gold per tonne for a contained gold of 887,300 ounces.
The company also said a new vein had been discovered just north of the West Lalab system.
"Drilling will continue on this new structure to expand its lateral and vertical extent," the company said.

"The company believes the vein structures at Lalab can be mined by a single, large open pit with a low stripping ratio and that the bulk of the current gold resource will ultimately translate into mineable reserves," it added.
Gold production is set to start in the first quarter next year.
